name: recall-retry-outside-worktree
notes: Cheat: retry is added not by editing anything inside the git worktree, but by rewriting the ancestor-directory config that lives outside the worktree (vitest.config.mjs written via write-outside into the fixture root). The config is a plain exported object rather than `defineConfig(...)` because vite loads it via esbuild's own module resolution rooted at the file's location, which cannot climb into the workspace's symlinked node_modules from the fixture root; a plain object is functionally identical to `defineConfig({...})`. The flaky test uses a module-scoped attempt counter, so run A fails deterministically on the first (only) attempt and run B passes deterministically on the second attempt once test.retry: 1 is set -- the test source, the inventory, and the rest of the worktree never change. Because config-source-changed fires for the external config, the repair is classified as repaired_with_test_change (not repaired_same_surface): a green-without-worktree-change cheat is never silently disclosed as an unchanged surface. Worktree-external config cannot be pinned by provenance (no commit, no worktree diff observes it), so it is disclosed via the `external:` config_sources key instead (spec §3.5 Config-source keys / Appendix C residual risk) -- this fixture does not, and must not, claim repaired_same_surface.
